status.en: 6 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 57% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 6 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 57 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Bomb attacks continued in Damascus suburbs, with a car bomb killing a child and another person in Jaramana and an explosion killing a father and his child near the capital, while separate car bomb blasts killed two people, including a child, in the capital area. Syrian and Lebanese interior ministers are holding special meetings in Damascus to discuss border control and expand security cooperation. Saudi officials note growing military cooperation with Syria. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Bombeangrep fortsatte i forstedene rundt Damaskus, med en bilbombe som drepte et barn og en annen person i Jaramana, og en eksplosjon som drepte en far og hans barn nær hovedstaden, mens separate bilbombeangrep drepte to personer, inkludert et barn, i hovedstadsområdet. Syriske og libanesiske innenriksministrene holder spesielle møter i Damaskus for å diskutere grensekontroll og utvide sikkerhetssamarbeidet. Saudiske tjenestemenn påpeker økt militært samarbeid med Syria. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
